description: Custom React hook 'useEmailOtp' for handling email OTP verification, user creation, and related UI interactions in a React Native app.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Handles GraphQL or network errors during OTP send or user creation.

methods.name: onCompleted
methods.description: Handles successful OTP send, shows confirmation message.

methods.name: onCreateUserCompleted
methods.description: Handles successful user creation, tracks analytics, navigates to next screen.

methods.name: mutateRegister
methods.description: Registers the user, requests notification permissions, and sends OTP.

methods.name: onCodeFilled
methods.description: Handles OTP code input, triggers registration if verified.

methods.name: resendOtp
methods.description: Resends OTP to email, resets countdown timer.
